title: Jesus Christ Who Came to Save
author: Martin Luther (1483-1546)
credit: Martin Luther, 1524.  Translated by Leonard Woolsey Bacon, 1883.

tunes.name: Jesus Christus Unser Heiland, Der Den Tod (Klug)

firstLine: Jesus Christ, who came to save,
verses: Jesus Christ, who came to save,
And sin hath bound in prison.
And brings us to God's favor.
Life and mercy, sin and death,
All in His hands He hath;
